VOLATILITY LAB / An open research starting point.
UNDER THE SURFACE

Quotes in. Evidence out.

The Python project contains the numerical engine, provider adapter, interactive Streamlit app, and automated tests. This browser edition explores precomputed synthetic fixtures from that same engine.

  1. Validate quotes. Reject zero bids, crossed markets, wide spreads and invalid inputs. The audit preserves every exclusion.
  2. Invert the model. Solve Black–Scholes–Merton at the bid/ask midpoint with bracketed bisection, then reprice to check the residual.
  3. Check stability. Reject boundary prices and quotes with extremely small vega. IV search is capped at 500%.
  4. Inspect slices. Compare smiles at a given expiry and the closest-to-spot strike across time. Missing values remain gaps.

Run with your own data

pip install -r requirements.txt
streamlit run app.py

Choose Yahoo Finance to fetch a ticker, or upload a CSV with strike, days, bid, ask, kind. Rates and dividend yield are explicit assumptions. Download the quote audit and snapshot to preserve your experiment.

Know the limits

US stock/ETF options can allow early exercise; European-model IV is only an approximation for those contracts. Provider quotes can be delayed, stale or asynchronous. No live fetch takes place in this browser demo.
